question: In 1722, Sawai Raja Jai Singh was given the governorship of which of the following regions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agra**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• **Sawai Raja Jai Singh** was a prominent ruler of the Amber Kingdom (later Jaipur) in the 18th century. He was known for his administrative acumen, military prowess, and significant contributions to astronomy and architecture. 
 
• In **1722**, Sawai Raja Jai Singh was appointed as the **governor of Agra** by the Mughal Emperor Muhammad Shah. This position was a mark of trust and recognition of his capabilities. 
 
• The region of **Agra** was a vital part of the Mughal Empire due to its historical significance, administrative importance, and strategic location. 
 
• Jai Singh's governorship of Agra allowed him to exert considerable influence in northern India and enhance his stature among the regional rulers. 
 
• While serving as the governor of Agra, Jai Singh continued to focus on his scientific and architectural pursuits, which included the construction of several **Jantar Mantars (astronomical observatories)**. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **Historical Significance of Agra:** 
 
 
• Agra was the capital of the Mughal Empire during the reign of Akbar, Jahangir, and Shah Jahan before the capital shifted to Delhi. 
 
• The city is home to several iconic architectural marvels, including the **Taj Mahal**, **Agra Fort**, and **Fatehpur Sikri**. 
 
• Agra's strategic location along the Yamuna River made it an important administrative and trade hub during the Mughal era. 
 
 
 
• **Contributions of Sawai Raja Jai Singh:** 
 
 
• Jai Singh was a celebrated astronomer and mathematician who built five astronomical observatories across India, known as **Jantar Mantars**. 
 
• He redesigned the city of Jaipur in Rajasthan, which is considered one of the earliest planned cities in India, with a unique blend of Vedic and modern architecture. 
 
• Jai Singh's contributions to science and urban planning earned him widespread acclaim and a lasting legacy. 
 
 
 
• **Other Governorships:** 
 
 
• During the Mughal period, regional governors or Subedars were appointed to oversee the administration, law, and revenue collection of specific provinces. 
 
• Sawai Raja Jai Singh also served as the governor of Malwa earlier in his career, further showcasing his administrative capabilities. 
 
 
 
• **Mughal Emperor Muhammad Shah:** 
 
 
• Muhammad Shah ruled from **1719 to 1748** and is known for his efforts to stabilize the declining Mughal Empire. 
 
• He relied on loyal and capable governors like Jai Singh to maintain order and strengthen the empire's hold over key regions. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Governorship of Agra:** Agra was a significant assignment for any governor, as it was one of the most prominent provinces in the Mughal Empire. 
 
• **Jai Singh’s Legacy:** Beyond his administrative roles, Jai Singh’s legacy is defined by his contributions to astronomy and urban planning. 
 
• **Subedar System:** Under the Mughal administrative structure, governors like Jai Singh were responsible for maintaining law and order, collecting revenue, and overseeing the welfare of their provinces.
